jobs.name: Vault curation — first protected session
jobs.prompt: Send Avi a concise reminder that this is the protected 60-minute vault curation session. Session scope: (1) process the newest Aug. 23–24 operational reports and the Dewey importer static review; (2) reconcile what belongs in durable operating references versus what stays in Atlas/_Inbox; (3) establish a repeatable handoff-card/return-artifact protocol based on the successful Dewey pilot; (4) add the missed Education Revenue Lanes exploration as an explicit reschedule-or-close decision: TPT, institutional buyers, and reusable SPED IP; note Avi is seeing more education and business-adjacent lanes; (5) record a future Hostinger capability review once Avi regains login access—inventory the advertised tools/agentic features, compare them to the existing VPS/Hermes stack, and identify only clear incremental value; do not enable trials, spend, create services, grant access, or change hosting without Avi’s separate approval; (6) update only Avi-approved files, preserving source artifacts and no bulk moves. Start by listing candidate files and proposed destinations; do not move, delete, or rewrite material unless Avi explicitly approves during the session. Include the outstanding weekend carryovers: Hollow's scoped Prime-local-Qwen calibration response; add/verify the populate-from-sales supply-row exclusion before any live run; importer remains Delivered-only (Option A) and awaits Kathleen’s three sticker numbers; decide weekly Palmstreet earnings source; Amazon Ads API authorization/COGS inputs; Vine enrollment after FBA available count turns positive. Also assess whether Buzz should remain parked rather than be reassessed, given Hermes bot-mode developments; do not configure Buzz, Hermes bot mode, API servers, peers, or networking in this session.
